summary: CoinShares PLC filed a routine Form 6-K for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2026, with no special-situation transaction disclosed. The XBRL-tagged exhibit references ordinary interim financial data, including line items for non-executive directors, the StableMint and Komainu entities, ETP product series, and historical Vine Hill SPAC-related accounts. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated in the excerpt. Such a periodic foreign-private-issuer report is functionally equivalent to a US domestic quarterly filing. Risk-arb angle: no event; watch future 6-K filings for any strategic action.
